name: EPIC 212335603
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 8.6 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212335603 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.606954 (16th-84th percentiles 8.265361-8.963369), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212335603 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.00279 (16th-84th percentiles 0.908449-1.105353), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212335603: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4756.3003 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212335603 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1113.994141 (16th-84th percentiles 1078.408203-1150.087891), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.18 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,114 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.00 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,756 K at its surface.
